Spent some time exploring @Vultisig’s new on-chain plugin marketplace.

The setup is elegant: you bu
company.description:
Spent some time exploring @Vultisig’s new on-chain plugin marketplace.

The setup is elegant: you build or use plugins that run on Vultisig’s MPC infrastructure, which means your private keys never leave your custody. 

DCA, payroll, recurring transfers, or any custom automation executes according to rules you define.

And there’s also instant permission revocation if you need to stop a plugin.

Support for 30+ chains makes it immediately useful for multi-chain users, and devs can build, submit for review, and distribute their automation tools.

What stood out most to me was how intuitive the UX feels given the complexity under the hood.

I ran a few sample plugins, including a simple recurring $ETH transfer and an auto DCA strategy into their token $VULT

Everything executed exactly as expected.

Have to say, it’s one of the most promising multi-chain automation setups I’ve tested recently.

company.title: 🔥STABLECOIN NEWS: Trump’s Fed nominee Kevin Warsh is drawing scrutiny over his crypto connections.
company.description:
🔥STABLECOIN NEWS: Trump’s Fed nominee Kevin Warsh is drawing scrutiny over his crypto connections.

Here’s what’s happening:

Warsh’s ties to Anchorage Digital and Cantor Fitzgerald are raising new questions about potential influence on the Tether-linked $USAT stablecoin project.

Anchorage provides custody services to major crypto firms, while Cantor Fitzgerald is a key partner behind Tether’s U.S. Treasury holdings. 

Together, those links could give Warsh unusual proximity to one of the most systemically important players in digital assets.

Critics worry this creates blurred lines between future Fed policy and private stablecoin interests, especially as the Trump administration continues pushing for U.S. dominance in digital finance.

Supporters argue Warsh’s experience could bring much-needed expertise to the Fed’s crypto oversight.

Either way, his nomination highlights how deeply digital assets are now tied to monetary policy.
